theater: 涼州賀蘭山與興慶府北黃河

battle.name: 河南、涼州之戰
battle.theater: 涼州賀蘭山與興慶府北黃河
battle.brief: 一〇四九年遼興宗再度親征西夏。河南道都統蕭惠沿黃河北進而不立營柵，沒藏訛龐縱兵自高坡下衝、萬箭齊發，遼軍大潰。十月北道都統耶律敵魯古率阻卜諸部趨涼州，至賀蘭山破夏軍三千騎，景宗皇后沒藏氏被俘。火攻止於火箭火炬，希臘火從未東傳。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 交戰的兩方是遼朝與西夏，這是他們第二次大規模開戰，一〇四四年那場遼夏之戰，遼興宗親征反被西夏打崩，御用器服與車騎盡失，顏面掃地；西夏一方也因景宗驕狂、國庫空虛、民怨積累而急欲休兵，宋夏和議因此得以推進。到了一〇四九年，景宗暴崩，年幼的幼主李諒祚即位，實權落在其舅、外戚沒藏訛龐手中，政令出於一家。遼方由興宗自將，分三路大軍：河南道行軍都統韓國王蕭惠統南路，趙王蕭孝友、漢王貼不為副都統；北道行軍都統耶律敵魯古領阻卜諸部軍自北郡南下，直趨涼州；中路由皇太弟天齊王耶律重元與北院大王耶律仁先為前鋒，興宗親率主力繼進。遼軍是契丹、奚、漢、渤海兵混編的集團軍，阻卜諸部以騎兵為主力，配有戰艦與糧艘沿黃河隨行。西夏以興慶府為都，涼州為右廂重鎮，唐隆鎮扼黃河通道，沒藏訛龐一面調涼州、興州諸城守軍，一面拒絕交出早年叛入西夏的党項部族。北宋則置身事外，陝西邊防由韓琦、范仲淹先後整頓，朝廷不助任何一方，一〇五〇年西夏把遼俘送回宋境時，宋朝下令邊將拒收。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Liao dynasty and Western Xia, and this was their second large-scale war. The first Liao-Xia conflict of 1044 had ended in disaster for Liao: Emperor Xingzong's own expedition had been beaten back by the Xia, and his ceremonial robes, wagons and horses had all been captured, leaving him humiliated. The Xia, for their part, were exhausted by the campaigns of their late Jingzong, had an empty treasury, and were suffering popular unrest, which is why they wanted a settlement with Song and why the Song-Xia peace talks went ahead. In 1049 Jingzong died suddenly; his young son Li Liangzuo, the Yizong, succeeded him, and real power passed to his maternal uncle Mozang Nepang, who as an outside relative monopolised every decision of state. Liao fielded three separate armies under Xingzong's own command. The southern route was led by the Prince of Han, Xiao Hui, as Henan Circuit Army Commander-in-Chief, with the Prince of Zhao Xiao Xiaoyou and the Prince of Han Tiebu as deputy commanders. The northern route was led by Yelü Dilugu, Northern Route Army Commander-in-Chief, who took the Zubu tribal cavalry south from the Bei commandery directly toward Liangzhou. The central route had the emperor's half-brother, the Prince of Tianqi Yelü Chongyuan, and the Prince of the Northern Court Yelü Renxian as vanguard, with Xingzong himself following with the main body. The Liao army was a mixed force of Khitan, Xi, Han and Bohai troops, with the Zubu tribes supplying most of the cavalry, and it moved along the Yellow River supported by warships and grain barges. On the Xia side the capital was Xingqing Prefecture; Liangzhou was the great stronghold of the Right Division and Tanglong Town commanded the Yellow River crossing. Mozang Nepang mustered the garrisons of Liangzhou and Xingzhou while refusing to hand back the Tangut tribes who had fled into Xia years earlier. The Northern Song kept well out of it. Its frontier in Shaanxi was being reorganised in turn by Han Qi and Fan Zhongyan, the court helped neither side, and when the Xia sent Liao prisoners back across the Song border in 1050, the Song ordered its border commanders to refuse to accept them.
people: 關鍵人物集中在兩軍的指揮層。遼興宗耶律宗真是這場戰爭的推手：他記着上一次被西夏打崩的舊恥，又看準西夏「新君幼弱、強臣用事」的時機，決定再舉親征；其人好大喜功而剛愎自用，屢不納諫。河南道行軍都統蕭惠是他的臂膀，卻是全軍最敗的一環——他把鎧甲盡載車上、軍士不得乘馬，數日不立營柵、不設偵候，諸將請求嚴加戒備，他回答「諒祚必自迎車駕，何暇及我？無故設備，徒自弊耳」，正是這份輕敵讓西夏的突襲得手，他本人幾乎不能脫身。北道行軍都統耶律敵魯古是另一種模範：他率阻卜諸部南下至賀蘭山，親自大呼奮擊，破夏軍扼險之騎，遼方宿將蕭慈氏奴、南克耶律斡里陣亡，夏軍潰散，景宗皇后沒藏氏、官僚與家屬盡被擄去。西夏方面，實際的決策者是權臣沒藏訛龐，他力主據賀蘭山險隘拒守，又在蕭惠驕惰無備時立刻抓住時機反擊；部將猥貨、乙靈紀在金肅城下戰死，窪普負重傷遁走，訛都被擒時連輜重器械都丟在陣地。一〇五二年西夏請與遼和親，興宗不許；一〇五五年道宗即位後局勢鬆動，一〇五八年毅宗親政，漫咩擒殺沒藏訛龐父子，政權才回到李氏手上。戰中還有伶官羅衣輕插科打諧，趁興宗敗走喘息時笑問「陛下您看看鼻子還在嗎」——西夏人慣於割去遼俘的鼻子示辱，興宗聞言發怒，末了卻自己笑了，也自知此敗全因自己之故。北宋方面，范仲淹於皇祐元年再出知延州、兼陝西經略安撫副使，上《答手詔條陳十事》主張修城寨、練弓弩、備器械、固漕運，與遼夏這一仗同在一條北方邊防線上。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities sit in the two command groups. Liao Emperor Xingzong, Yelü Zongzhen, drove the war: he remembered the humiliation of the previous defeat at Xia's hands, spotted the moment when the Xia state showed a new young ruler on the throne with a powerful minister holding the real power, and resolved to campaign in person once more. He was vainglorious and obstinate by temperament and repeatedly refused his advisers. Xiao Hui, Prince of Han and Commander-in-Chief of the Henan Circuit Army, was the emperor's right-hand man and also the worst link in the chain: he loaded all the armour onto carts, kept his men from riding, set up no palisade and posted no scouts for several days, and when his generals asked for strict precautions he answered that the Xia ruler would come out to greet the imperial carriage and had no time to spare for us, and that unprovoked readiness would only weaken us. That arrogance was precisely what the Xia counterstroke exploited, and Xiao Hui barely escaped with his life. Yelü Dilugu, Commander-in-Chief of the Northern Route, was the opposite model: he led the Zubu cavalry south to the Helan Mountains, shouted his men forward in person, broke the Xia horse that held the pass, and saw his own seasoned officers Xiao Chishinu and Nanke Yelü Wolie fall in the fight, while the Xia force collapsed and the empress dowager Mozang, the wife of Jingzong, was taken away together with officials and their families. On the Xia side the real decision-maker was the regent Mozang Nepang, who insisted on holding the Helan passes and seized the instant Xiao Hui's carelessness to counterattack. His commanders Weihuo and Yilingji were killed during the Xia attack on Jinsu City in the second month of 1050, Wapu escaped badly wounded, and when the Xia commander Edou was captured he lost his baggage and weapons on the field. In 1052 the Xia asked for a marriage alliance with Liao and was refused. In 1055 the accession of Emperor Daozong eased the situation, and in 1058, once Yizong took personal rule, the general Manye seized and executed Mozang Nepang and his sons, returning power to the Li house. An episode of the campaign shows the other side as well: the court jester Luo Yiqing teased the breathless Xingzong after his flight with the question of whether the emperor's nose was still there, a barb about the Xia habit of cutting off the noses of Liao captives. Xingzong raged, then laughed at himself, admitting that the disaster was entirely his own fault. On the Song side, Fan Zhongyan returned to Yanzhou in the first year of Huangyou as deputy commissioner of the Shaanxi pacification administration, and in his reply to the imperial rescript laid out ten proposals urging the building of fortified towns, the drilling of crossbowmen, the stockpiling of equipment and the securing of grain transport, on the very frontier line that the Liao-Xia war was being fought over.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是拜占庭的希臘火，公元六百七十年前後問世，靠的既不是弓弦也不是火藥的壓力，而是可燃混合劑本身。放到一〇四九年的遼夏戰場上比對就很有意義：拜占庭人用銅管把燃燒劑壓出銅口，或裝在船首，或架在城頭，配合以石灰與松脂熬成的粗劣混合物，點火即成白晝的火牆，能黏在水面上燃燒，能順風覆敵舟，配方則是帝國的絕密。中原並沒有這一套東西。遼軍此戰的裝備核心是騎兵的弓箭、刀槍與鎧甲，河南道軍把鎧甲裝載在車上，士卒不得乘馬，一旦遭突擊便來不及披甲；其後勤靠「戰艦糧艘」，沿黃河列陣綿亘數百里，攻城則倚賴楯車與投石。西夏在涼州方向以三千騎扼賀蘭山險隘，靠馬力與地勢取勝，糧秣靠橐駝與牛車穿越河套與河西走廊。火攻的規模也小：箭上帶火、油瓶、火炬與簡單的猛火油灑擲而已，絕無銅管噴射之器。希臘火的配方是拜占庭帝國的絕密，連配方帶船一起沉入海底，從未東傳到河西，因此它在此役中只能作為一個「以火阻騎」的對照物：兩者相隔近四百年，一個是帝國的技術壟斷，一個是邊地的簡易燃燒手段。
kitsEn: The piece of ordnance on the card is Byzantine Greek fire, which appeared around 670 CE. What drove it was neither the tension of a bowstring nor the pressure of gunpowder, but the combustible mixture itself. Set that against the Liao-Xia battlefield of 1049 and the comparison is instructive. The Byzantines forced the burning mixture out of a copper tube: the siphon was mounted either at a ship's prow or on a city wall, and was fed with a crude compound of quicklime and resin, so that ignition at once produced a wall of flame in broad daylight, a mixture that clung to the surface of the water and burned, and one that could be driven downwind onto enemy shipping; the formula itself was the empire's strictest secret. Nothing of that kind existed in the Chinese middle kingdom. The core of the Liao equipment in this war was the archery, sabres and spears and the lamellar armour of its cavalry. The Henan Circuit army loaded its armour onto carts and did not let its men ride, so that a surprise left the soldiers unable to put on their armour at all. Its logistics rested on warships and grain barges, drawn out for several hundred li along the Yellow River, and for siege work it relied on shielded carts and stone-throwers. The Xia, for their part, met the threat in the Liangzhou sector with three thousand cavalry holding the Helan passes, winning by horse and ground, and moved grain by camel and ox-cart across the Hetao loop and the Hexi Corridor. Their use of fire was equally modest: fire-tipped arrows, oil jars, torches and simple splashing of crude oil, and nothing resembling a copper siphon. The formula of Greek fire was a Byzantine state secret, and both the formula and the ships went down with the vessel; it never travelled east to the Hexi. In this campaign it can therefore serve only as a foil for the idea of fire used to stop horsemen: the two sit nearly four centuries apart, one a monopoly on technique held by an empire, the other a crude incendiary practice on a frontier.
tactics: 遼軍的戰法是一次典型的多路戰役：南路由蕭惠沿黃河南岸與河道推進，戰艦糧艘隨行；北路由耶律敵魯古領阻卜諸部自北郡南下，目標是涼州；中路興宗自率大軍居中策應。蕭惠一軍的致命處在於放棄了遼軍向來倚賴的野戰節奏——不立營柵、不設偵候、鎧甲在車、士卒不乘馬，等於把騎兵弓射與衝陣的長項全部廢掉；遼軍真正的技術優勢本來就是騎射，蕭惠自恃「諒祚必自迎車駕」，實際上正被沒藏訛龐利用。西夏的應對分兩段：在黃河戰線上，夏軍不與遼軍列陣對射，而是待其疲於行軍、營壘未成的間隙，選高坡俯衝，萬箭齊發，一舉打散中軍；到了賀蘭山，則以三千騎據險扼守，倚山險硬拒北路大軍，但缺乏步卒與遠射器械掩護，終被阻卜騎兵正面衝垮，兩名遼將陣亡、夏軍潰散，連景宗皇后與大批官屬家屬都被擄去。遼軍此後轉為縱深打擊：西夏退地，遼軍長驅，圍興州、逼興慶府，最後奇襲賀蘭山西北的攤糧城，盡發廪積，切斷夏國的儲糧。而西夏的戰術是堅壁與清野：一面各城閉門拒守、避免野戰，一面在遼軍深入時退地、斷糧、焚燒，使遠征的遼軍糧道越拉越長。火攻在整個過程中只是輔助手段，靠火箭與火炬燒敵營和糧車，談不上以火阻騎的專門兵器。
tacticsEn: The Liao plan was a classic multi-axis campaign. The southern route under Xiao Hui advanced along the south bank of the Yellow River and up the channel itself, warships and grain barges moving in company. The northern route under Yelü Dilugu took the Zubu peoples down from the Bei commandery with Liangzhou as its objective. The central route, commanded by Xingzong in person, followed to support them. The fatal weakness of Xiao Hui's force was that it gave up the rhythm on which Liao campaigning depended: no palisade, no scouts, the armour on the carts and the soldiers on foot. It threw away precisely the Liao strengths of mounted archery and the charge, and the Liao advantage had always been horse and bow. Xiao Hui's confidence that the Xia ruler would come out to greet the emperor was turned straight against him by Mozang Nepang. The Xia reply came in two stages. On the Yellow River front they refused to meet the Liao in a set battle; instead they waited until the Liao columns were tired from the march with their camps not yet established, then launched the charge down from high ground with a shower of arrows that broke the Liao centre in one stroke. In the Helan Mountains they put three thousand cavalry on the passes and relied on the terrain to hold off the northern army, but without infantry or missile troops in support they were overrun by the Zubu horse; two Liao officers were killed, the Xia force broke, and the empress dowager and a great part of the Xia civil establishment and their families were carried off. The Liao then converted to a war of depth: as the Xia fell back the Liao drove on, ringed Xingzhou, pressed in on Xingqing Prefecture, and finally surprised the granary city of Tanliang in the northwest of the Helan range, emptying its storehouses and cutting the Xia state's grain. The Xia in turn fought a war of walls and scouring: every city closed and refused to be drawn into open battle, and as the Liao drove deep the Xia gave up ground, cut supplies and burned what they left behind, stretching the grain road of an invading army further and further. Fire in all of this was an auxiliary measure only: fire-arrows and torches used against camps and baggage wagons, and nothing approaching a dedicated weapon for stopping horsemen.
data: 能核實的數字大致如下。遼軍三路出擊，兵員史無詳數，但九月蕭惠所部的推進規模記錄得很清楚：戰艦與糧艘「綿亘數百里」，沿黃河行軍數日不立營柵。十月北道軍至賀蘭山時，西夏方面投入的守軍是三千騎，蕭惠部則遭萬箭齊發式的突擊，士卒死傷慘重，蕭惠幾乎不能脫身；同役遼方宿將蕭慈氏奴、南克耶律斡里陣亡。此戰縱跨的時間軸也很長：一〇四九年春興宗集兵，七月下詔親征、渡河入唐隆鎮，九月南路遇襲，十月北路的涼州之役；一〇五〇年二月夏軍圍金肅城反而失敗，大將猥貨、乙靈紀陣亡、窪普中創遁走；三月三角川再戰，夏軍候者被斬八人，主將訛都被擒，輜重器械盡失；同年遼軍蕭蒲奴等圍興州，四面逼近興慶府，六月攻破攤糧城，盡發廪積。戰名中的「河南」並非今日的河南行省，而是遼朝河南道行軍蕭惠部的簡稱，戰場在興慶府以北的黃河中游；「涼州」在河西走廊北端、今甘肅武威，兩處相距約一千里，即五百餘公里。從一〇四九年七月下詔到一〇五二年十月進獻誓表，前後折騰了三年多。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked run roughly as follows. The Liao sent out three columns, and no figures survive for their strength, but the scale of Xiao Hui's advance in the ninth month is recorded clearly: warships and grain barges stretched for several hundred li, and the army marched for several days along the Yellow River without establishing a camp. When the northern column reached the Helan Mountains in the tenth month, Xia had committed three thousand cavalry to hold the passes, while Xiao Hui's force was caught by the arrow storm and suffered heavy casualties, Xiao Hui himself barely escaping; in the same action the seasoned Liao officers Xiao Chishinu and Nanke Yelü Wolie were killed. The campaign ran a long time axis. In the spring of 1049 Xingzong mustered the troops; in the seventh month he issued the edict for the personal expedition and crossed the river into Tanglong Town; in the ninth month the southern route was ambushed; in the tenth month came the Liangzhou action of the northern route. In the second month of 1050 the Xia besieged Jinsu City and failed, the generals Weihuo and Yilingji being killed and Wapu escaping with a wound; in the third month they were beaten again at Sanjiaochuan, eight of their scouts being killed, the commander Edou captured and their baggage and weapons lost. In the same year Xiao Punu and others ringed Xingzhou, pressed in on all sides of Xingqing Prefecture, and in the sixth month broke open Tanliang and carried off everything in the granaries. The Henan of the battle's name is not today's Henan province but a shorthand for the Henan Circuit army of Xiao Hui, and its field was the middle Yellow River north of Xingqing Prefecture. Liangzhou lay at the northern end of the Hexi Corridor, in what is now Wuwei, Gansu; the two places are about one thousand li, some five hundred kilometres, apart. From the edict of the seventh month in 1049 to the oath submitted in the tenth month of 1052, the business took more than three years.
cause: 起因有兩層，近因是國恥，遠因是邊界的利益糾葛。一〇四四年第一次遼夏之戰，興宗親率大軍深入西夏境內數百里，深入之後才發現西夏「向無城堡可守」而夏軍並不與其正面交鋒，反在賀蘭山以宋軍對遼的戰法包抄掩擊，把遼軍打崩。興宗單騎突圍，器服車騎盡為夏軍所獲，遼方宿將多人被俘，西夏人還慣於割去遼俘的鼻子示辱，此後遼廷「無鼻子」成了國恥。而西夏並不安分：景宗拒絕交納早年叛入的党項部族，對遼使傲慢無禮，與宋議和之後又暗通款曲。景宗死後，年幼的毅宗李諒祚即位，沒藏訛龐以外戚身份專權，拒絕遼方的冊封並扣留遼使，遼夏之間的舊怨與新衝突疊在一起。興宗等的就是這個窗口：他相信西夏幼弱而強臣用事正是雪恥良機，遂於一〇四九年春會集諸路兵馬，七月下詔親征，同時遣使告宋，要求宋朝不要支援西夏。宋朝沿用上一次的態度，坐山觀虎鬥，既想看兩家互耗，也不想放棄與西夏議和的籌碼；它既不接應西夏的求援，也不動用自己的邊軍趁火打劫。
causeEn: The cause has two layers: an immediate one of national humiliation and a deeper one of rivalry over the frontier. In the first Liao-Xia war of 1044, Xingzong led a great army deep into Xia territory for several hundred li before discovering that Xia had no fortified castles to defend and that the Xia army would not stand and fight him; instead it outflanked and struck the Liao in the Helan Mountains, using against the Liao the methods the Song had taught it, and the Liao army broke. Xingzong broke out on horseback alone, his ceremonial robes, wagons and horses falling into Xia hands, and Liao officers were captured, the Xia being given to cutting off the noses of Liao prisoners as a mark of humiliation, so that going about without a nose became a byword at the Liao court. The Xia were not the injured party, however. Jingzong refused to hand back the Tangut tribes who had fled into Xia years before, was insolent to Liao envoys, and after making peace with Song kept up secret contacts with it. When Jingzong died, his young successor Yizong Li Liangzuo came to the throne and Mozang Nepang, an uncle by marriage, monopolised power as the regent, refusing the Liao's canonisation of the new emperor and detaining Liao envoys; old feuds and fresh incidents piled on top of one another. Xingzong waited for exactly this opening. Convinced that a Xia state ruled by a boy under a strong minister was his chance to wipe out the old disgrace, he mustered the armies of the various circuits in the spring of 1049, issued the edict for his personal expedition in the seventh month, and at the same time sent envoys to Song to demand that Song not support the Xia. Song took the same posture as in the previous war and sat on the fence, wanting to see the two sides exhaust each other while keeping its own options for a settlement with the Xia open: it answered no call for help from Xia, but it did not commit its own frontier troops to a profitable strike either.
impact: 短期看，這場戰爭把西夏推向更被動的位置。景宗皇后沒藏氏——毅宗的生母、沒藏訛龐的胞妹——在賀蘭山被擄，遼軍不但沒有放人，反而在次年把俘虜作為要脅的籌碼送回宋境試探，把宋朝拖進尷尬的處境；沒藏訛龐在夏國的威望由此重挫。遼軍隨後深入，圍興州、攻興慶府、破攤糧城，國中儲糧盡失，西夏不得不靠各城堅壁與清野硬撐，經濟與人口都受重創。中期看，遼夏之間再沒有回到一〇四二年宋夏和議那樣的均勢，兩國直到一〇五五年道宗即位後才逐步正常化，經過一〇五八年毅宗誅除沒藏訛龐父子、扶立梁氏為后，才算真正翻篇。對北宋而言，這是一段寶貴的喘息：宋廷在旁觀的同時抓緊整頓陝西邊防，范仲淹主持延州，築城寨、練弓弩、改用鄉兵與蕃兵，把三川口、好水川、定川寨三場敗仗留下的教訓一併消化，十年後宋夏再度交鋒時，朝廷手上已有可以與西夏周旋的本錢；涼州、賀蘭山一線也在此後數十年裡固定在西夏右廂，成為宋夏邊界上最敏感的一段，而唐隆鎮留在遼朝手中，成為雙方反覆交涉的舊帳。
impactEn: In the short term the war pushed Western Xia into a more passive position. The empress dowager Mozang, mother of Yizong and sister of the regent Mozang Nepang, was carried off at the Helan Mountains, and the Liao did not release her; the following year they used their prisoners as a bargaining counter and shipped them back across the Song border to test the Chinese court, dragging Song into an awkward position, and Mozang Nepang's standing inside the Xia state suffered badly. The Liao then drove deep, ringed Xingzhou, struck at Xingqing Prefecture and broke open the granary city of Tanliang, so that the state's reserve grain was gone and Xia had to hold on behind closed walls and scorched earth, its economy and its population both badly damaged. In the medium term neither Liao nor Xia returned to the balance that had followed the Song-Xia settlement of 1042; only after the accession of Daozong in 1055 did relations begin to normalise, and even then the matter was not truly settled until 1058, when Yizong destroyed Mozang Nepang and his sons and installed Liang as empress. For the Northern Song the campaign was a precious breathing space. While sitting on the fence the court pressed ahead with the reform of its Shaanxi frontier: Fan Zhongyan directed the work at Yanzhou, building fortified towns, drilling crossbowmen, and reorganising the reliance on local militia and native tribes, so that the lessons of the three defeats at Sanchuankou, Haoshuichuan and Dingchuanzhai could all be digested at once; by the time Song and Xia fought again ten years later the court had the means to hold its own against Xia. The Liangzhou and Helan line also settled for the next several decades as part of the Xia Right Division, becoming the most sensitive stretch of the Song-Xia border, while Tanglong Town stayed in Liao hands as an old debt that the two sides would argue over repeatedly.
result: 結局是遼軍先勝後平，兩國都沒有得到想要的東西。遼軍在河南道靠突襲得手，在涼州方向靠阻卜騎兵硬壓過賀蘭山，奪取涼州前哨、俘虜夏國皇太后與大批官屬，看似大勝；但一〇五〇年西夏在唐隆、金肅城、興州一線連續反擊，兩月之內猥貨、乙靈紀陣亡、三角川再敗、訛都被擒，輜重器械盡失，沒藏訛龐屢次上表求和都被興宗駁回——遼方索回叛逃部族不許，夏國進降表被指「表不如式」，進貢不納、請婚不許，直到一〇五二年十月才獲准進獻誓表，而遼只賜車服，仍不許誓詔。疆界上，遼軍雖攻入興慶府、破攤糧城，卻沒有能長期佔領任何城池，反把西夏推成死敵；唯一實惠是唐隆鎮留在遼朝手中不還，興宗以地介河西、不置戍守為由拖延，此後西夏多次請復未果。戰爭的最後贏家其實是時間：一〇五五年遼道宗即位後轉向懷柔，一〇五八年毅宗親政、誅殺沒藏訛龐父子，夏政歸李氏，遼夏關係回到以封貢和親為主的常態；西夏則在此後宋夏戰爭中失去主動，涼州與唐隆一線再未回到宋手裡，而這場戰爭留下的教訓，最終是被宋廷用一座座城寨與一副副弓弩慢慢補上的。
resultEn: The outcome was a Liao victory followed by stalemate, with neither side getting what it wanted. The Liao won on the Henan route by surprise and forced its way over the Helan Mountains in the Liangzhou direction on the swords of the Zubu cavalry, taking the Xia outposts of Liangzhou, capturing the Xia empress dowager and a great part of the Xia civil establishment, and it looked like a crushing success. But in 1050 the Xia counterattacked along the line of Tanglong, Jinsu City and Xingzhou, and within two months Weihuo and Yilingji were killed, the army was beaten again at Sanjiaochuan, Edou was taken and the baggage and weapons were lost. Mozang Nepang's appeals for peace were rejected by Xingzong again and again: Liao would not give back the rebel tribes, the Xia submission was dismissed as not in proper form, its tribute was not accepted and its request for a marriage alliance was refused, and only in the tenth month of 1052 was the Xia permitted to submit an oath, for which Liao granted robes and chariots but still withheld the oath itself. On the ground the Lao army, though it reached Xingqing Prefecture and broke open Tanliang, could not hold any city for long and instead made a determined enemy of the Xia; the one solid gain was Tanglong Town, which Liao kept, on the pretext that the place lay between the rivers and was left ungarrisoned, and the Xia asked for its return several times without success. In the end time was the real victor: Daozong's accession in 1055 brought a more conciliatory Liao policy, Yizong took personal rule in 1058 and executed Mozang Nepang and his sons, the Xia state returned to the Li house, and Liao-Xia relations settled back into the routine of investiture, tribute and proposed marriage. The Xia, for their part, lost the initiative in the Song-Xia wars that followed, and the Liangzhou and Tanglong line never came back to Song hands. What the campaign really taught was absorbed on the Song side, town by town and bowstring by bowstring, into a frontier that the Chinese court rebuilt one fortified village at a time.
